Having seized part of Hsin's authority, Suhsin the Inevitable replicated Hsin's method for making Kernel Puppets and built one solely for war, the Formrender.

They tear into Autopuppets and raid repair workshops again and again, cutting down the Celestials' Artisan Autopuppets to stall the Civilization Capsule's restoration.

To enhance their capabilities even further, Suhsin the Inevitable poured in the fervor and rage that saturate the Heart of Flames. The Formrenders became more powerful but steadily slid into chaos and frenzy, until even their Kernels were twisted along with them.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Formrender |zhs = 解形煞 |zht = 解形煞 |ja = 形解きの悪鬼 |ko = 해형살 |fr = Déchireforme |de = Formlöser |es = Desgajador |th = Formrender |pt = Quebra-Formas }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
